; AppLoad's minimize button drops a full-screen app to a small window, and bringing
; it back takes two taps. This makes it one tap each way, so a full-screen app and
; a notebook can be switched between. PaperTerm also asks for it from its menu, by
; writing a new value to a file, since an app has no other way to ask AppLoad.
AFFECT /appload/qml/window.qml
TRAVERSE FocusScope
LOCATE BEFORE ALL
INSERT {
    property bool resumeFullscreen: false
    property bool minimizeRequestSeen: false
    property string lastMinimizeRequest: ""

    function toggleMinimized() {
        if(root.fullscreen) {
            root.maximize();
            root.x = (root.globalWidth - root.width) / 2;
            root.y = 0;
            root.resumeFullscreen = true;
            root.minimized = true;
        } else if(root.minimized && root.resumeFullscreen) {
            root.resumeFullscreen = false;
            root.minimized = false;
            root.maximize();
        } else {
            root.resumeFullscreen = false;
            root.minimized = !root.minimized;
        }
    }

    function receiveMinimizeRequest(request) {
        if(!root.minimizeRequestSeen) {
            // A request left over from an earlier visit must not minimize a new window.
            root.minimizeRequestSeen = true;
            root.lastMinimizeRequest = request;
        } else if(request != root.lastMinimizeRequest) {
            root.lastMinimizeRequest = request;
            if(!root.minimized) root.toggleMinimized();
        }
    }

    Timer {
        interval: 500
        repeat: true
        running: root.appName == "PaperTerm"
        triggeredOnStart: true
        onTriggered: {
            var request = new XMLHttpRequest();
            request.onreadystatechange = function() {
                if(request.readyState == XMLHttpRequest.DONE) {
                    root.receiveMinimizeRequest(request.responseText);
                }
            };
            request.open("GET", "file:///tmp/paperterm-minimize");
            request.send();
        }
    }
}
TRAVERSE Rectangle#topbar > Rectangle#minimizeButton
LOCATE AFTER ALL
INSERT {
    MouseArea {
        anchors.fill: parent
        onClicked: () => root.toggleMinimized()
    }
}
END TRAVERSE
END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
